spec: specification/effects.mdx, What This Page Does Not Add, rule 4; specification/failures.mdx, enclosing-member disqualification
prelude: import { Context } from 'vibelang/context'; import { Layer } from 'vibelang/provider'; abstract class C extends Context { abstract value(): number }

cases.name: transitive requirement
cases.source: function read() { return C.context().value() } function* values() { yield read(); }

cases.name: async generator
cases.source: async function* values() { await Promise.resolve(); yield C.context().value(); }

cases.name: ambient syntax is refused before row inference
cleanup requirement
cases.source: function* values() { try { yield 1; } finally { C.context().value(); } }

cases.name: providing only iterator creation cannot provide resumption
cases.source: function* values() { yield C.context().value(); } export function main() { const iterator = Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C, { value: () => 7 }), () => values()); return iterator.next().value; }

cases.name: declared failure without a failing body
cases.source: class Boom extends Error {} function* values(): Result<number, Boom> { return 1; }

cases.name: pure generator stays ordinary
cases.source: function* values() { yield 1; yield 2; } export function main() { return [...values()].join(','); }

cases.name: internally provided requirement leaves an empty row
cases.source: function* values() { yield Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C, { value: () => 7 }), () => C.context().value()); } export function main() { return [...values()].join(','); }

cases.name: ordinary iterator methods may carry provided requirements
cases.source: const values = { [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<number> { return [C.context().value()][Symbol.iterator](); } }; function read() { const [first] = values; let total = 0; for (const value of values) total += value; return [first, total, ...values].join(','); } export function main() { return Layer.provide(Layer.succeed(C, { value: () => 7 }), () => read()); }

cases.name: ordinary iterator methods retain unsupplied requirements
cases.source: const values = { [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<number> { return [C.context().value()][Symbol.iterator](); } }; function read() { return [...values].join(','); } export const unprovided = read();
